Antigravity Context Inspector

A minimalist, live Context Window & Subagent Inspector side panel for the Antigravity 2.0 desktop app.

Watch interactive walkthrough (Sparkline · MCP Servers · Settings · Swarm)
--- ## Highlights - **Exact token accounting — not character guesses.** Reads the actual `ContextWindowMetadata` breakdown and prompt payload stored in `~/.gemini/antigravity/conversations/.db` (read-only), paired with live model limits from Antigravity’s model catalog. Zero extra LLM tokens consumed. - **Turn-by-turn growth sparkline.** Crisp 44px SVG sparkline right below the context bar shows token growth across turns with per-turn markers, compaction drops, labeled budget thresholds, and effortless full-card hover telemetry. - **Native window & request trim budget.** Shows both the model’s native context capacity (e.g. `1M`) and Antigravity’s per-request compaction/trim budget (e.g. `512k`, `256k`, or `128k`) — switchable as the primary meter via `⚙` Settings. - **Prompt cache drop alert & session summary.** Flags unexpected prompt cache drops (`Cache 18% ↓`) in amber when caching was previously active, and expands a 1-line session summary (`turns · avg cache · total out · thinking`) on click. - **Minimalist single-page overview with MCP server breakdown & inline peek.** Click any category to rank items by token cost, drill into **MCP servers** (`github`, `supabase`, …) before inspecting individual tool schemas, and peek or copy exact payloads sent to the model. - **Subagent & Swarm Worker monitoring.** Automatically detects both `invoke_subagent` subagents and **Swarm workers** (`members.json`), displaying live status, token usage, and full `← Main` / `Open ↗` drill-down. - **Configurable `/compact` control & persisted `⚙` settings.** Configure compact threshold (`50%`, `60%`, `75%`, `Off`), primary meter (`Native` / `Budget`), and compact action (`Send /compact` with two-step confirmation or 1-click `Copy only`) — persisted outside iframe storage in `settings.json`. - **Native Dark & Light mode.** Syncs automatically with Antigravity’s live theme variables via the sidecar preload bridge. - **Zero external dependencies.** Runs entirely on Antigravity’s bundled Node.js runtime using built-in modules (`node:sqlite`, `node:crypto`, `node:fs`) — no Python required, no `npm install`, no build step. --- ## Requirements - **Antigravity 2.0 Desktop** (no Python or external runtime needed) --- ## Installation ### Option 1 — One-line installer (recommended) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sametozbalkan/antigravity-context-inspector/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sametozbalkan/antigravity-context-inspector/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` ### Option 2 — `git clone` **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/sametozbalkan/antigravity-context-inspector.git "$HOME\.gemini\config\plugins\context-inspector" ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/sametozbalkan/antigravity-context-inspector.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-inspector ``` ### Enable the side panel 1. Open **Antigravity → Customizations → Installed** and make sure **Context Inspector** is enabled (restart Antigravity if it does not appear immediately). 2. Open any conversation and select **Context Inspector** from the right-hand side panel **`+`** menu. --- ## Updating Context Inspector supports three ways to stay up to date: 1. **In-panel update notification:** The sidecar checks GitHub Releases quietly in the background (cached every 12 hours). When a newer version is published, a subtle `vX.Y.Z available` pill appears in the footer: - If installed via `git`, click **Update now** to run `git pull --ff-only` explicitly, then toggle the plugin off and on in Customizations. - You can also copy the update command or open the GitHub Release notes without modifying files automatically. 2. **Manual `git pull`:** ```bash git -C ~/.gemini/config/plugins/context-inspector pull --ff-only ``` 3. **Re-run the one-line installer:** Running `install.ps1` / `install.sh` again updates an existing installation in place. --- ## Native Context vs. Request Budget Models like Gemini expose a **1M-token native context window**, while Antigravity applies a smaller per-request **trim / compaction budget** (for example `512k`, `256k`, or `128k` depending on the model) to keep latency low and prevent long-turn context degradation. - The large top bar shows usage against the model’s **native window**. - The **Budget** row shows usage against Antigravity’s **active trim threshold** — the point where older history starts getting compacted or trimmed. - The **Compact** button appears when usage reaches **60%** of the active budget (or 60% of the native window when no separate budget applies). --- ## Architecture ```text antigravity-context-inspector/ ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── assets/logo.svg # Plugin icon ├── scripts/ │ ├── install.ps1 # Windows PowerShell installer/updater │ └── install.sh # macOS / Linux installer/updater ├── sidecars/inspector/ │ ├── sidecar.json # Registers AUX_PANE side panel │ ├── package.json │ ├── main.mjs # Sidecar HTTP server, in-process snapshot cache, mtime-cached static assets, model catalog, update check │ ├── inspector.mjs # Standalone Node.js CLI entrypoint │ ├── lib/ │ │ ├── protobuf.mjs # Minimal zero-copy wire decoder (BigInt + Uint8Array.subarray) │ │ ├── accounting.mjs # Read-only node:sqlite loader, token breakdown, checkpoints, file detection │ │ ├── subagents.mjs # Subagent & Swarm worker discovery and stats │ │ ├── content.mjs # System sections, tool schemas, active messages │ │ ├── snapshot.mjs # Snapshot assembler, CLI text formatter & SHA-1 fingerprinting │ │ └── server_utils.mjs # Pure server helpers (light report index, workspace URI validation, settings, semver) │ └── public/ │ ├── index.html # HTML shell (loads classic /app.js) │ ├── styles.css # Theme-aware minimalist CSS │ ├── app.js # Panel state, API polling, delegated click handling │ └── js/ │ ├── utils.js # Formatting, escaping, clipboard & path helpers │ ├── sparkline.js # Turn-by-turn SVG sparkline & hover telemetry │ └── views.js # Pure HTML template renderers └── tests/ ├── helpers.mjs # Shared synthetic protobuf & SQLite test builders └── *.test.mjs # Modular node:test suites (protobuf, accounting, subagents, content, CLI, server helpers, frontend) ``` ### How it works 1. The panel receives the active conversation ID and workspace URIs from Antigravity’s `/preload.js` bridge and polls `/api/report` every 3 seconds while visible. 2. `main.mjs` fingerprints the conversation’s `.db` and `-wal` files (plus Swarm `members.json` and any discovered subagent databases) and only invokes `buildSnapshot()` in-process when something actually changed. 3. All database connections open strictly read-only via Node’s built-in `node:sqlite` (`DatabaseSync` with `{ readOnly: true }`). Full item payloads are served instantly from the backend’s in-memory LRU cache via `/api/item` when you click to inspect a row. --- ## CLI Usage & Testing The Node.js parser also works standalone from the command line (Node.js 22.16+ / 24+): ```bash # Latest Antigravity Desktop conversation node sidecars/inspector/inspector.mjs # Specific conversation ID as structured JSON node sidecars/inspector/inspector.mjs --conversation-id --json # Arbitrary SQLite conversation database node sidecars/inspector/inspector.mjs --db /path/to/.db ``` Run the zero-dependency test suite: ```bash node --test tests/*.test.mjs ``` --- ## License [MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 [Samet Ozbalkan](https://github.com/sametozbalkan)
